records.title: 通知与招募：国际会议志愿者
records.route: 通知 / 招募
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
You are supposed to write for the Postgraduates’ Association a notice to recruit volunteers for an international conference on globalization. The notice should include the basic qualifications for applicants and the other information which you think is relevant.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Use “Postgraduates’ Association” instead. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 活动背景、招募对象、资格要求、相关信息、署名格式

stages.title: 先搭骨架
stages.description: 先写活动目的，再写职责/资格，最后补报名方式和截止时间。

stages.title: 再升级表达
stages.description: 用 opportunity 表达“机会”，用 essential/enable 等表达补充价值，但不要为了塞高级词而改变原意。

records.exercise: 请用英文写一句：本次会议将为志愿者提供与国际参与者交流的机会。
records.reference_answer: The conference will provide volunteers with an opportunity to interact with international participants.
records.teaching_demo: The conference will provide volunteers with an opportunity to interact with international participants. Applicants with relevant experience will be given priority.

records.title: 图画作文：文化交流与融合
records.route: 积极现象 / 价值论证
records.theme: 文化交流、文化多样性与融合
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should
1) describe the drawing briefly,
2) explain its intended meaning, and
3) give your comments.
You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points)
task_atoms: 发表评论/倡导开放包容
functions: 发表评论/倡导开放包容

stages.title: 描述画面
stages.description: 先写画面里真实可见的元素，再借助图画与说明文字提炼主题。

stages.title: 提炼寓意
stages.description: 从“文化元素融合”上升到开放、交流、相互理解，而不是只重复图中物体。

stages.title: 论证价值
stages.description: 用 foster / strengthen / social cohesion 等表达说明文化交流如何产生积极影响。

records.exercise: 请写一句：文化多样性有助于促进相互理解并增强社会凝聚力。
records.reference_answer: Cultural diversity can foster mutual understanding and strengthen social cohesion.
records.teaching_demo: Cultural diversity can foster mutual understanding and strengthen social cohesion. Beyond its immediate benefits, cultural exchange can generate lasting gains for society.

records.title: 推荐信：推荐一部电影
records.route: 推荐 + 理由
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
Write a letter to a friend of yours to
1) recommend one of your favorite movies and
2) give reasons for your recommendation.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 推荐对象 + 推荐理由；写给朋友，语气友好但表达清楚。

stages.title: 先写理由
stages.description: 至少给出一个具体优点，不要只说 good 或 interesting。

stages.title: 把词块落地
stages.description: beneficial/enhance 等词要接合适的对象；推荐信的核心仍是“推荐什么、为什么适合”。

records.exercise: 把“我推荐这部电影，因为它能拓宽你的视野”写成自然的英文推荐理由。
records.reference_answer: I would recommend this movie because it can broaden your horizons and expose you to a new perspective.
records.teaching_demo: I am writing to wholeheartedly recommend this movie to you. What sets it apart is its compelling story and thought-provoking exploration of human relationships.

records.title: 图画作文：旅游文明与环境责任
records.route: 负面现象 / 危害与治理
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should
1) describe the drawing briefly,
2) explain its intended meaning, and
3) give your comments.
You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points)

stages.title: 描述与识别
stages.description: 先客观描述画面中的行为，再指出它与文明旅游/环境责任之间的冲突。

stages.title: 写清危害
stages.description: 用 detrimental / exacerbate / impede 等词表达具体后果，不要只写 it is bad。

stages.title: 从个人到治理
stages.description: 可以提出游客责任、公众教育或适度监管；措施应与问题对应。

records.exercise: 请写一句：如果不加以处理，不文明旅游行为可能进一步加剧环境问题。
records.reference_answer: If left unaddressed, irresponsible tourist behavior may exacerbate existing environmental problems.
records.teaching_demo: If left unaddressed, irresponsible tourist behavior may exacerbate existing environmental problems. Targeted measures can mitigate the adverse effects, while public education can encourage more responsible conduct.

records.title: 欢迎与建议：国际学生的校园生活
records.route: 欢迎 + 建议
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
Some international students are coming to your university. Write them an email in the name of the Students’ Union to
1) extend your welcome and
2) provide some suggestions for their campus life here.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 先表达欢迎，再提出校园生活建议，并说明建议的价值。

stages.title: 建议要具体
stages.description: 建议句后最好接一个效果，不要只罗列 should。

stages.title: 词汇联动
stages.description: facilitate 强调“促进某过程”；enable 强调“使某人能够做某事”，两者不能随意互换。

records.exercise: 请给新来的国际学生提一条建议：参加社团活动有助于他们结识朋友。
records.reference_answer: Joining student clubs can facilitate social interaction and help international students make friends.
records.teaching_demo: I would encourage you to join a student club, as it can facilitate social interaction and help you adapt to campus life.

records.title: 图画作文：乐观与悲观的心态
records.route: 正反对比 / 品质价值
records.theme: 乐观与悲观的心态差异
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions：
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay you should
1) describe the drawing briefly
2) explain its intended meaning, and
3) give your comments.
You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points)

stages.title: 描述对比
stages.description: 两个人面对同一处境时的态度或行动有什么不同？先把对比写清楚。

stages.title: 提炼观点
stages.description: 重点不是简单说“乐观好、悲观坏”，而是说明态度如何影响行动。

stages.title: 展开论证
stages.description: 用 resilience / bolster / navigate 解释积极心态怎样帮助人面对困难。

records.exercise: 请写一句：积极的心态能增强人们面对挫折时的韧性。
records.reference_answer: A positive outlook can strengthen people's resilience in the face of setbacks.
records.teaching_demo: A positive outlook can bolster people's confidence and strengthen their resilience in the face of setbacks. It does not remove every obstacle, but it can help people navigate difficulties more constructively.

records.title: 邀请信：邀请外教担任演讲比赛评委
records.route: 邀请
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
Write an e-mail of about 100 words to a foreign teacher in your college, inviting him/her to be a judge for the upcoming English speech contest.
You should include the details you think necessary.
You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the e-mail. Use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 邀请对象、具体角色、活动背景及必要细节。

stages.title: 句块组装
stages.description: 先发出邀请，再解释为什么邀请对方，最后补时间地点和期待回复。

stages.title: 语气控制
stages.description: cordially invite 和 would be grateful if... 是正式邀请表达；不要同一封信重复三次邀请。

records.exercise: 请写一句正式邀请：鉴于您在英语教学方面的经验，希望您担任比赛评委。
records.reference_answer: Given your expertise in English teaching, we would be grateful if you could serve as a judge for the contest.
records.teaching_demo: On behalf of the Students’ Union, I cordially invite you to serve as a judge for the upcoming English speech contest. Given your expertise in English teaching, your participation would add considerable value to the event.

records.title: 图画作文：毕业后的多元选择
records.route: 多元选择 / 理性判断
records.theme: 毕业后的多元选择与人生道路
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should
1) describe the drawing briefly,
2) interpret its intended meaning, and
3) give your comments.
You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)

stages.title: 描述选择
stages.description: 先概括图中呈现的不同人生路径，不要过早替人物下结论。

stages.title: 承认差异
stages.description: 多元选择题通常不是判断某条路绝对正确，而是比较选择背后的目标与代价。

stages.title: 提出判断原则
stages.description: 用 weigh the pros and cons / strike a balance / autonomy 等表达建立自己的判断标准。

records.exercise: 请写一句：合理的选择应考虑个人兴趣、能力和长期目标。
records.reference_answer: A sensible decision should take into account personal interests, abilities, and long-term goals.
records.teaching_demo: Each option offers distinct benefits while involving different trade-offs. A sensible decision should take into account personal interests, abilities, and long-term goals.

records.title: 建议信：改善学生身体状况
records.route: 建议 / 改善方案
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
Write a letter of about 100 words to the president of your university, suggesting how to improve students’ physical condition.
You should include the details you think necessary.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 写信给校长，提出改善学生身体状况的建议。

stages.title: 建议写成可执行动作
stages.description: 例如改善设施、安排活动、提供指导；避免只有抽象口号。

stages.title: 说明效果
stages.description: 用 can enhance... 或 This can go a long way toward... 解释建议为什么有用。

records.exercise: 请写一句建议：学校应采取有效措施，鼓励学生定期参加体育活动。
records.reference_answer: The university should take effective measures to encourage students to engage in regular physical activity.
records.teaching_demo: One practical step would be to provide more accessible sports facilities. This would not only encourage regular exercise but also enhance students’ overall well-being.

records.title: 图画作文：亲情、孝老与代际关爱
records.route: 价值肯定 / 关系与责任
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should
1) describe the drawing briefly,
2) interpret its intended meaning, and
3) give your comments.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)

stages.title: 描述时间/行为
stages.description: 先描述画面中体现的代际关系或行为，再概括其变化或对照。

stages.title: 提炼价值
stages.description: 将画面上升到责任、感恩、互相关爱等价值，但避免空泛说“family is important”。

stages.title: 把价值写具体
stages.description: 用 foster / underpin / cohesion 说明关爱如何影响关系与社会风气。

records.exercise: 请写一句：代际关爱能够培养相互尊重并增强家庭凝聚力。
records.reference_answer: Intergenerational care can foster mutual respect and strengthen family cohesion.
records.teaching_demo: Intergenerational care can foster mutual respect and strengthen family cohesion. Its value lies not only in meeting practical needs, but also in sustaining meaningful family bonds.

records.title: 推荐信：为读书会推荐一本书
records.route: 推荐 + 理由
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
You are going to host a club reading session. Write an email of about 100 words recommending a book to the club members.
You should state reasons for your recommendation.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming ” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 推荐一本书 + 给出推荐理由；要结合读书会的使用场景。

stages.title: 理由要落到对象
stages.description: 可以写内容、可读性、启发性或对读者的具体帮助。

stages.title: 迁移而非背题
stages.description: 2011 的电影、2015 的书、2017 的景点，推荐结构可以复用，但优势内容必须随对象改变。

records.exercise: 请写一句：这本书能帮助读者加深对不同文化的理解。
records.reference_answer: This book can enhance readers’ understanding of different cultures.
records.teaching_demo: I am writing to wholeheartedly recommend this book to the club members. What sets it apart is its engaging narrative and its ability to enhance readers’ understanding of different cultures.

records.title: 图画作文：手机时代的聚会
records.route: 负面现象 / 人际沟通
records.theme: 手机依赖对现实人际交往的影响
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following picture. In your essay, you should
1）describe the picture briefly,
2）interpret its intended meaning, and
3）give your comments.
You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)

stages.title: 描述反常场景
stages.description: 先写聚会场景中人与手机的关系，再点出它与面对面交流的反差。

stages.title: 解释问题
stages.description: 把表层的“看手机”解释为注意力分散、现实互动减少或人际疏离。

stages.title: 危害与措施
stages.description: exacerbate 用于“加剧已有问题”，impede 用于“妨碍目标/进程”；最后提出个人行动与环境支持。

records.exercise: 请写一句：如果不加以处理，过度使用智能手机可能加剧面对面交流的问题。
records.reference_answer: If left unaddressed, excessive smartphone use may exacerbate existing problems in face-to-face communication.
records.teaching_demo: If left unaddressed, excessive smartphone use may exacerbate existing problems in face-to-face communication. Targeted measures can mitigate the adverse effects, but individuals must also make a conscious effort to engage with people around them.

records.title: 通知：向新生介绍图书馆信息
records.route: 通知 / 信息说明
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
Suppose you are a librarian in your university. Write a notice of about 100 words, providing the newly-enrolled international students with relevant information about the library.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 对象是新入学国际学生；核心是提供实用信息，不是泛泛宣传图书馆。

stages.title: 按信息优先级组织
stages.description: 服务内容、开放时间/地点、使用规则或报名方式。

stages.title: 检查遗漏
stages.description: 通知类要让读者看完知道“做什么、何时、何地、如何参与”。

records.exercise: 请写一句：新生可以在截止日期前提交申请，以获得图书馆导览服务。
records.reference_answer: New students can submit their applications before the deadline to take part in the library tour.
records.teaching_demo: The library tour is designed to help newly enrolled international students become familiar with our facilities. Those who are interested should register before the deadline.

records.title: 图画作文：家庭教育中的言传身教
records.route: 正反对比 / 榜样作用
records.theme: 家庭教育中的言传身教
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following pictures. In your essay, you should
1) describe the pictures briefly,
2) interpret the meaning, and
3) give your comments.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)

stages.title: 描述两图对比
stages.description: 先说明图中成年人/孩子的行为差异，避免第一段直接开始讲道理。

stages.title: 指出榜样机制
stages.description: 核心不是简单说“父母很重要”，而是说明孩子会观察并模仿日常行为。

stages.title: 论证长期影响
stages.description: 用 underpin / foster / perpetuate 解释行为示范如何塑造习惯。

records.exercise: 请写一句：父母的日常行为能够长期塑造孩子的习惯。
records.reference_answer: Parents' everyday behavior can shape children's habits over time.
records.teaching_demo: Parents' everyday behavior can shape children's habits over time. By setting a positive example, adults can foster responsibility and strengthen children's confidence.

records.title: 推荐信：向新到任教授推荐旅游景点
records.route: 推荐 + 理由
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
You are to write an email to James Cook, a newly-arrived Australian professor, recommending some tourist attractions in your city. Please give reasons for your recommendation.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 推荐本市景点 + 给出理由；考虑收信人是刚到任的外国教授。

stages.title: 理由具体化
stages.description: 可写文化特色、交通便利、体验价值，而不是只说 beautiful。

stages.title: 把表达迁移到对象
stages.description: 推荐结构不变，但电影、书籍、景点的优势不能机械照搬。

records.exercise: 请写一句：这个景点尤其适合第一次来本市的游客，因为交通便利且文化特色鲜明。
records.reference_answer: I believe this attraction would suit first-time visitors particularly well because it is easy to reach and rich in local culture.
records.teaching_demo: I am writing to recommend several tourist attractions in our city. What sets the old town apart is its distinctive architecture and rich cultural heritage.

records.title: 图画作文：拥有书籍与真正阅读
records.route: 正反对比 / 行动与习惯
records.theme: 拥有知识资源与真正付诸阅读的区别
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following pictures. In your essay, you should
1）describe the pictures briefly,
2）interpret the meaning, and
3）give your comments.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)
task_atoms: 论证阅读实践的重要性
functions: 论证阅读实践的重要性

stages.title: 描述两种状态
stages.description: 区分“拥有书籍”和“实际阅读”这两种行为，不要把画面描述写成抽象评论。

stages.title: 提炼中心
stages.description: 强调资源本身并不等于收获，关键在于是否采取行动。

stages.title: 把观点写具体
stages.description: enable / facilitate / unlock 可分别表达使能、促进过程和释放潜力，注意选择最贴合的词。

records.exercise: 请写一句：真正的阅读能拓宽视野，而不仅仅是拥有书籍。
records.reference_answer: Reading can broaden people's horizons; learning depends on engagement with ideas rather than merely owning books.
records.teaching_demo: Owning books does not automatically lead to learning. Reading enables people to engage with ideas, broaden their horizons, and unlock their potential.

records.title: 邀请信：邀请国际专家参加毕业典礼
records.route: 邀请 + 时间地点
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
Write an email to all international experts on campus inviting them to attend the graduation ceremony. In your email you should include time, place and other relevant information about the ceremony.
You should write about 100 words neatly on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name at the end of the email. Use “Li Ming” instead.
(10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 邀请所有在校国际专家参加毕业典礼，并明确时间、地点及相关信息。

stages.title: 信息必须落地
stages.description: 邀请句不能替代时间地点；题目点名要求的信息必须逐项检查。

stages.title: 句块复用
stages.description: CORE-010 可跨2013/2018/2022复用，槽位只换成具体活动与角色。

records.exercise: 请写一句：典礼定于六月二十日在大学礼堂举行。
records.reference_answer: The ceremony is scheduled for June 20 at the university auditorium.
records.teaching_demo: On behalf of the university, I cordially invite you to attend the graduation ceremony. The event is scheduled for June 20 at the university auditorium.

records.title: 图画作文：选课时的功利取向
records.route: 问题批判 + 价值选择
records.theme: 选课价值取向：求知成长还是功利求易
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should
1) describe the picture briefly,
2) interpret the meaning, and
3) give your comments.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET.（20 points）

stages.title: 描述两种标准
stages.description: 概括图中不同选课标准或态度，尤其是求知成长与功利取向的反差。

stages.title: 揭示潜在假设
stages.description: 思考是否把“容易得分/短期回报”误当成学习的唯一目标。

stages.title: 提出判断原则
stages.description: 使用 trade-offs / strike a balance / reconcile 等表达，而不是简单判定某一类课程没有价值。

records.exercise: 请写一句：关键在于在眼前的便利与长期的智识成长之间取得平衡。
records.reference_answer: The key is to strike a balance between immediate convenience and long-term intellectual growth.
records.teaching_demo: The key is to strike a balance between immediate convenience and long-term intellectual growth. A sensible decision should take into account personal interests, abilities, and long-term goals.

records.title: 回复邮件：介绍乡村小学援助项目
records.route: 回复询问 / 介绍说明
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
Suppose you are working for the “Aiding Rural Primary School” project of your university. Write an email to answer the inquiry from an international student volunteer, specifying the details of the project.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in the email. Use “Li Ming” instead. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 回复对方询问，介绍项目细节；不是邀请信，也不是推荐信。

stages.title: 先回应，再说明
stages.description: 开头回应来信，主体提供项目目的、参与方式或进展，结尾表示愿意补充信息。

stages.title: 注意信息完整
stages.description: 题目要求 specify the details；不能只写项目的价值而遗漏实际安排。

records.exercise: 请写一句：该项目旨在帮助乡村小学生接触更多学习资源。
records.reference_answer: The project aims to give rural primary school students access to more learning resources.
records.teaching_demo: Thank you for your email regarding the project. It aims to offer rural primary school students access to learning resources, and we have completed the initial recruitment stage.

records.title: 图画作文：坚持、调整节奏与面对困难
records.route: 正反对比 / 挫折应对
records.theme: 坚持、调整节奏与面对困难
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should
1) describe the picture briefly,
2) interpret the implied meaning, and
3) give your comments.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)
task_atoms: 分析适度休整与继续行动
functions: 分析适度休整与继续行动

stages.title: 描述情境
stages.description: 写清面对困难时的行动或节奏差异。

stages.title: 解释寓意
stages.description: 坚持不等于盲目硬撑；图画更适合引导学生讨论坚持与合理调整。

stages.title: 论证并评论
stages.description: resilience / withstand / navigate 等表达要服务于“如何应对困难”的具体论证。

records.exercise: 请写一句：坚持能够增强人们面对挫折时的韧性。
records.reference_answer: Perseverance can strengthen people's resilience in the face of setbacks.
records.teaching_demo: Perseverance can strengthen people's resilience in the face of setbacks. At the same time, knowing when to adjust one's pace can help people navigate difficulties sustainably.

records.title: 通知：告知国际学生歌唱比赛
records.route: 活动通知
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
The Students Union of your university has assigned you to inform the international students about an upcoming singing contest. White a notice in about 100 words.
Write your answer on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in the notice. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 通知国际学生即将举行歌唱比赛，重点是把活动信息说清楚。

stages.title: 通知骨架
stages.description: 活动目的/名称 → 时间地点 → 参与方式/截止时间。

stages.title: 原题文字提醒
stages.description: 真题母库保留了源文件中的 “White a notice”；这里按母库原文展示，不擅自替换原题文字。

records.exercise: 请写一句：比赛将于下周五在学生中心举行，欢迎有兴趣的同学报名。
records.reference_answer: The contest will be held next Friday at the Student Center, and interested students are welcome to register.
records.teaching_demo: The Students’ Union is pleased to announce an upcoming singing contest. The event is scheduled for next Friday at the Student Center; those interested should register before the deadline.

records.title: 图画作文：良好习惯、时间管理与拖延
records.route: 正反对比 / 自律与长期影响
records.theme: 良好习惯、时间管理与拖延
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should
1) describe the picture briefly,
2) interpret the implied meaning, and
3) give your comments.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)

stages.title: 描述习惯对比
stages.description: 先说明两种不同的时间使用/行为习惯。

stages.title: 解释长期影响
stages.description: 从眼前的轻松与长期的结果之间建立因果关系。

stages.title: 提出行动建议
stages.description: 可以写目标拆分、计划安排、持续执行；不要只喊“be disciplined”。

records.exercise: 请写一句：缺乏计划可能阻碍实现长期目标的进程。
records.reference_answer: A lack of planning can impede progress toward long-term goals.
records.teaching_demo: A lack of planning can impede progress toward long-term goals. By fostering better habits and using time deliberately, people can make steady progress rather than postpone important tasks.

records.title: 建议信：给准备来中国求职的朋友提建议
records.route: 建议信
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
A foreign friend of yours has recently graduated from college and intends to find a job in China. Write him/her an email to make some suggestions .
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not sign your own name at the end. Use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write the address. ( 10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 给刚毕业、打算来中国找工作的外国朋友提建议。

stages.title: 建议要适配对象
stages.description: 语言、求职渠道、简历/面试准备等建议要围绕“在中国找工作”。

stages.title: 不要堆高级词
stages.description: 一到两处准确升级即可，重点是建议具体、理由清楚。

records.exercise: 请写一句建议：你应该提升中文沟通能力，并了解当地求职市场。
records.reference_answer: You should enhance your Chinese communication skills and learn more about the local job market.
records.teaching_demo: One practical step would be to enhance your Chinese communication skills. It may also be worthwhile to research the local job market and tailor your application accordingly.

records.title: 图画作文：兴趣选择、尊重与家庭支持
records.route: 价值选择 / 自主发展
records.theme: 坚持个人兴趣、尊重个体选择与家庭支持
records.prompt_text:
52. Directions:

1) describe the picture briefly,
2) interpret its intended meaning, and
3) give your comments.

stages.description: 先呈现家庭成员之间的态度差异，不要直接把一方写成完全错误。

stages.title: 提炼价值
stages.description: 围绕兴趣、个体差异、尊重与支持展开，而不是简单写“follow your dream”。

stages.title: 协调而非二选一
stages.description: reconcile 适合表达协调两个目标；autonomy/agency 的使用要有明确语境。

records.exercise: 请写一句：家庭支持能够增强年轻人的信心，同时尊重他们的自主性。
records.reference_answer: Family support can bolster young people's confidence while respecting their autonomy.
records.teaching_demo: Family support can bolster young people's confidence while respecting their autonomy. A sound approach should seek to reconcile parental guidance with individual interests and goals.

records.title: 邀请信：邀请英国教授组织创新竞赛团队
records.route: 邀请 / 组队任务
records.prompt_text:
51. Directions:
Write an email to a professor at a British university, inviting him/her to organize a team for the international innovation contest to be held at your university.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use “Li Ming” instead. (10 points)

stages.title: 拆任务
stages.description: 邀请对象是英国大学教授；核心动作不是“参加”，而是“组织一支队伍”。

stages.title: 把角色写准确
stages.description: [ROLE/ACTION] 槽位必须写 organize a team，而不能泛化成 attend the event。

stages.title: 邀请信迁移
stages.description: 2013 邀请担任评委、2018 邀请参加典礼、2022 邀请组队；骨架相似，角色槽位不同。

records.exercise: 请写一句：我们相信您的参与能够为竞赛带来重要价值。
records.reference_answer: We believe your participation would add considerable value to the contest.
records.teaching_demo: I cordially invite you to organize a team for the international innovation contest to be held at our university. Given your expertise, your participation would add considerable value to the event.

records.route: 正反对比 / 开放学习
records.theme: 开放学习、跨专业拓展与求知态度
records.prompt_text:

records.teaching_demo: Interdisciplinary learning can broaden people's horizons and expose them to new perspectives. It can also help bridge the gap between academic knowledge and practical problems.

stages.title: 检查可操作性

records.reference_answer: Applicants should demonstrate strong communication skills and a keen sense of responsibility.

sentence_blocks.template: To enrich students' campus life, [ORGANIZER] has decided to organize [EVENT].
sentence_blocks.zh: 为了丰富校园生活，[组织方]决定举办[活动]。

sentence_blocks.template: [EVENT] is scheduled for [DATE] at [PLACE].
sentence_blocks.zh: [活动]定于[日期]在[地点]举行。

sentence_blocks.template: The event will involve a variety of [ACTIVITIES], ranging from [A] to [B].
sentence_blocks.zh: 活动将包含多种[内容]，从[A]到[B]。

sentence_blocks.template: One highlight to look forward to is [HIGHLIGHT].
sentence_blocks.zh: 值得期待的一大亮点是[亮点]。

sentence_blocks.template: Those who are interested should submit [MATERIAL] before [DEADLINE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 感兴趣者应在[截止时间]前提交[材料]。

sentence_blocks.template: Once recruited, you will be responsible for [DUTY].
sentence_blocks.zh: 一经录用，你将负责[职责]。

sentence_blocks.template: Priority will be given to those who have experience in [FIELD].
sentence_blocks.zh: 有[领域]相关经验者优先。

sentence_blocks.template: An ideal candidate is expected to be able to [ABILITY].
sentence_blocks.zh: 理想候选人应能够[能力]。

sentence_blocks.template: Please note that the deadline is [DATE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 请注意截止日期为[日期]。

sentence_blocks.template: On behalf of [ORGANIZER], I cordially invite you to [ACTION].
sentence_blocks.zh: 我谨代表[组织方]诚邀您[行动]。

sentence_blocks.template: I am writing to extend an official invitation to you to attend [EVENT].
sentence_blocks.zh: 我写信正式邀请您参加[活动]。

sentence_blocks.template: Designed to [PURPOSE], the event will [CONTENT].
sentence_blocks.zh: 本次活动旨在[目的]，并将[内容]。

sentence_blocks.template: Attendees from different backgrounds will gather to exchange views on [TOPIC].
sentence_blocks.zh: 来自不同背景的与会者将围绕[主题]交流观点。

sentence_blocks.template: We would be honored if you could accept our invitation.
sentence_blocks.zh: 若您能接受邀请，我们将深感荣幸。

sentence_blocks.template: We look forward to seeing you at the event.
sentence_blocks.zh: 期待在活动现场见到您。

sentence_blocks.template: I am writing to offer my suggestions regarding [ISSUE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 我写信就[问题]提出几点建议。

sentence_blocks.template: It is highly recommended that [SUGGESTION].
sentence_blocks.zh: 强烈建议[建议]。

sentence_blocks.template: This can go a long way toward [GOAL].
sentence_blocks.zh: 这将对[目标]大有帮助。

sentence_blocks.template: Another viable option would be to [SUGGESTION].
sentence_blocks.zh: 另一个可行选择是[建议]。

sentence_blocks.template: I encourage you to consider [SUGGESTION], as it has proven effective in [GOAL].
sentence_blocks.zh: 建议你考虑[建议]，因为它已被证明有助于[目标]。

sentence_blocks.template: I sincerely hope that you will find my advice helpful.
sentence_blocks.zh: 真诚希望这些建议对你有帮助。

sentence_blocks.template: I am writing to wholeheartedly recommend [ITEM] to you.
sentence_blocks.zh: 我写信向你诚挚推荐[对象]。

sentence_blocks.template: Please allow me to explain why this is my top recommendation.
sentence_blocks.zh: 请允许我说明为什么它是我的首选推荐。

sentence_blocks.template: It is also noteworthy that [ADVANTAGE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 同样值得注意的是[优点]。

sentence_blocks.template: It has gained considerable popularity among [GROUP] due to [REASON].
sentence_blocks.zh: 由于[原因]，它在[群体]中颇受欢迎。

sentence_blocks.template: In light of these reasons, I have no hesitation in recommending it to you.
sentence_blocks.zh: 基于上述理由，我毫不犹豫地向你推荐它。

sentence_blocks.template: I would like to give a brief introduction to [TOPIC].
sentence_blocks.zh: 我想简要介绍一下[主题]。

sentence_blocks.template: [PROJECT] aims to offer a glimpse into [TOPIC].
sentence_blocks.zh: [项目]旨在让人初步了解[主题]。

sentence_blocks.template: Everything has been going smoothly so far, and we will continue to [ACTION].
sentence_blocks.zh: 目前一切进展顺利，我们将继续[行动]。

sentence_blocks.template: I hope this gives you a clearer understanding of [TOPIC].
sentence_blocks.zh: 希望这些信息能帮助你更清楚地了解[主题]。

sentence_blocks.template: Please feel free to contact me if you need further information.
sentence_blocks.zh: 如果需要更多信息，请随时联系我。

sentence_blocks.template: As vividly depicted in the picture, [SCENE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 如图生动所示，[画面]。

sentence_blocks.template: The picture portrays a thought-provoking scene in which [SCENE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 图画描绘了一幅发人深省的场景：[画面]。

sentence_blocks.template: The caption accompanying the picture conveys the core message that [MESSAGE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 图画说明文字传达了核心信息：[信息]。

sentence_blocks.template: Straightforward as it is, the picture carries profound implications.
sentence_blocks.zh: 图画虽直观，却蕴含深意。

sentence_blocks.template: The picture serves as a vivid reminder that [CLAIM].
sentence_blocks.zh: 这幅图有力提醒我们：[观点]。

sentence_blocks.template: The picture aims to draw public attention to [ISSUE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 这幅图旨在引起公众对[问题]的关注。

sentence_blocks.template: It is generally acknowledged that [X] is of paramount importance.
sentence_blocks.zh: 人们普遍认为[X]至关重要。

sentence_blocks.template: The importance of [X] cannot be overstated.
sentence_blocks.zh: [X]的重要性再怎么强调也不为过。

sentence_blocks.template: [X] plays an indispensable role in [Y].
sentence_blocks.zh: [X]在[Y]中发挥不可或缺的作用。

sentence_blocks.template: [X] serves as the cornerstone of [Y].
sentence_blocks.zh: [X]是[Y]的基石。

sentence_blocks.template: [X] can be highly beneficial to us in that [BENEFIT].
sentence_blocks.zh: [X]对我们很有益，因为[好处]。

sentence_blocks.template: [X] enables individuals to [ACTION], thereby [RESULT].
sentence_blocks.zh: [X]使人们能够[行动]，从而[结果]。

sentence_blocks.template: [X] is conducive to [NOUN/DOING].
sentence_blocks.zh: [X]有利于[名词/行动]。

sentence_blocks.template: [X] goes a long way toward [DOING].
sentence_blocks.zh: [X]对[行动]大有帮助。

sentence_blocks.template: By cultivating [X], we can reap lifelong benefits, such as [BENEFIT].
sentence_blocks.zh: 通过培养[X]，我们可以获得长期收益，例如[好处]。

sentence_blocks.template: Both individuals and society can derive a multitude of benefits from this trend.
sentence_blocks.zh: 个人与社会都能从这一趋势中获益良多。

sentence_blocks.template: Not only does [X] yield substantial benefits for individuals, but it also exerts a positive influence on society.
sentence_blocks.zh: [X]不仅使个人受益，也会对社会产生积极影响。

sentence_blocks.template: With regard to society, [X] can serve as an effective means of addressing [ISSUE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 从社会层面看，[X]可成为解决[问题]的有效途径。

sentence_blocks.template: In stark contrast to [A], [B] [ACTION].
sentence_blocks.zh: 与[A]形成鲜明对比的是，[B][行动]。

sentence_blocks.template: By comparison, [CLAIM].
sentence_blocks.zh: 相比之下，[观点]。

sentence_blocks.template: Some people tend to turn a blind eye to [ISSUE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 有些人往往对[问题]视而不见。

sentence_blocks.template: If left unchecked, [PROBLEM] will, in all likelihood, lead to adverse consequences.
sentence_blocks.zh: 若放任不管，[问题]很可能导致不良后果。

sentence_blocks.template: [PROBLEM] may become a stumbling block to [GOAL].
sentence_blocks.zh: [问题]可能成为实现[目标]的绊脚石。

sentence_blocks.template: [PROBLEM] is detrimental to [NOUN/DOING].
sentence_blocks.zh: [问题]不利于[名词/行动]。

sentence_blocks.template: [PROBLEM] may hinder us from [DOING].
sentence_blocks.zh: [问题]可能妨碍我们[行动]。

sentence_blocks.template: We may end up [RESULT], which is exactly the opposite of what we want.
sentence_blocks.zh: 我们最终可能[结果]，这恰恰与期望相反。

sentence_blocks.template: Some people maintain that [VIEW A].
sentence_blocks.zh: 一些人认为[观点A]。

sentence_blocks.template: Others attach particular importance to [VALUE] and therefore prefer [OPTION B].
sentence_blocks.zh: 另一些人更重视[价值]，因此倾向于[选择B]。

sentence_blocks.template: Both sides have some merit in their arguments.
sentence_blocks.zh: 双方观点都有一定道理。

sentence_blocks.template: It is necessary to weigh the pros and cons of each option before reaching a final decision.
sentence_blocks.zh: 作最终决定前，有必要权衡各方案的利弊。

sentence_blocks.template: What matters as well is to assess one's personal interests, abilities and goals.
sentence_blocks.zh: 同样重要的是评估个人兴趣、能力和目标。

sentence_blocks.template: This trend can be attributed to [CAUSE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 这一趋势可归因于[原因]。

sentence_blocks.template: [CHANGE] can mainly be ascribed to [CAUSE].
sentence_blocks.zh: [变化]主要可归因于[原因]。

sentence_blocks.template: [CAUSE] has led to a surge in [RESULT].
sentence_blocks.zh: [原因]导致[结果]显著增加。

sentence_blocks.template: With [BACKGROUND], there is an increasing tendency for people to [DOING].
sentence_blocks.zh: 随着[背景变化]，越来越多人倾向于[行动]。

sentence_blocks.template: It is imperative to [ACTION].
sentence_blocks.zh: 必须[行动]。

sentence_blocks.template: The authorities concerned should impose more stringent regulations on [ISSUE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 有关部门应对[问题]实施更严格的监管。

sentence_blocks.template: Prompt action should be taken to curb [PROBLEM].
sentence_blocks.zh: 应及时采取行动遏制[问题]。

sentence_blocks.template: It is essential to enhance the public's awareness of [ISSUE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 有必要提升公众对[问题]的认识。

sentence_blocks.template: Relevant institutions should take effective measures to create an environment conducive to [DOING].
sentence_blocks.zh: 相关机构应采取有效措施，营造有利于[行动]的环境。

sentence_blocks.template: To conclude, [CLAIM].
sentence_blocks.zh: 总而言之，[观点]。

sentence_blocks.template: Therefore, it is crucial for individuals to recognize the significance of [X] and [ACTION].
sentence_blocks.zh: 因此，个人有必要认识到[X]的重要性并[行动]。

sentence_blocks.template: Only in this way can we [GOAL].
sentence_blocks.zh: 只有这样，我们才能[目标]。

sentence_blocks.template: It can be observed from the chart that [TREND].
sentence_blocks.zh: 从图表可以看出[趋势]。

sentence_blocks.template: [A] underwent a progressive increase, while [B] witnessed [TREND].
sentence_blocks.zh: [A]持续上升，而[B]呈现[趋势]。

sentence_blocks.template: [A] stands at the top of the list, followed by [B] and [C].
sentence_blocks.zh: [A]位居首位，其后为[B]和[C]。

sentence_blocks.template: There is a clear correlation between [A] and [B].
sentence_blocks.zh: [A]与[B]之间存在明显相关关系。

sentence_blocks.template: The author's idea gets to the heart of the matter.
sentence_blocks.zh: 作者的观点切中了问题的核心。

sentence_blocks.template: [EXPERIENCE] can equip students with [SKILLS/PERSPECTIVE].
sentence_blocks.zh: [经历]可以使学生具备[技能/视野]。

sentence_blocks.template: Thank you for your email regarding [TOPIC].
sentence_blocks.zh: 感谢你关于[主题]的来信。

sentence_blocks.template: I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for [HELP].
sentence_blocks.zh: 我写信对[帮助]表达诚挚感谢。

sentence_blocks.template: I would like to offer my sincere apology for [ISSUE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 我想就[问题]表达诚挚歉意。

sentence_blocks.template: I am writing to raise a concern about [ISSUE].
sentence_blocks.zh: 我写信反映/投诉[问题]。

sentence_blocks.template: I am writing to apply for [POSITION/PROGRAM].
sentence_blocks.zh: 我写信申请[职位/项目]。

sentence_blocks.template: I am writing to ask whether you could [REQUEST].
sentence_blocks.zh: 我写信想请问您是否可以[请求事项]。

curriculum_logic: 真题原文是课程主线：28道任务，2010—2023每年Part A与Part B各一道。
100组词汇句块卡是统一的语言资源层：每卡保留中文功能、学生常写、高阶表达、核心句块、原卡例句、迁移例句、适用主题与使用边界。
190条核心高分句块是写作功能层：每道真题只推荐少量相关句块，完整句块库仍可搜索。
双向映射：真题可以找到推荐表达；表达卡可以返回关联真题；句块可以返回其原工作簿明确标注的真题映射。
标签口径：本题核心 = 当前任务优先学习；迁移拓展 = 语义上可迁移的教学建议，不代表原题原文出现过该词；示范句 = 编辑教学示例，不是官方范文。
完成目标：先完成本题任务，再完成句块调用与迁移练习；表达掌握状态由学习者自评。
